newsitem.title: USA: Telebit to pay $200,000 to settle suit.
newsitem.headline: Telebit to pay $200,000 to settle suit.

text.p: Telebit Corp said on Monday it would pay $200,000 to settle class action litigation shareholders brought against the company in 1995.

Telebit said in a statement it had reached an agreement-in-principle to settle the case against it and several company officers. The remainder of the $2 million settlement would be paid by insurance, it said.
The plaintiffs initially estimated damages to be over $20 million, Telebit said.
Telebit said it decided to settle in order to avoid further legal expenses.

"While Telebit continues to deny each of the plaintiffs' claims in their entirety, settlement at this stage and in this amount clearly is in the company's best interests," Chief Financial Officer Brian Cohen said in a statement.
Certain shareholders who bought Telebit stock alleged violations of the federal securities law in the litigation, the company said.
The settlement was subject to the signing of a definitive agreement and approval by the federal district court in Boston, it said.
